proofUses.reason: Intended prose proof: compute a finite cylinder under the product Bernoulli law. This is a prerequisite plan, not extracted Lean evidence.
A definition; it invokes no other wiki assertion.
Indicators of independent uniforms below q(e) are independent Bernoulli(q(e)) coordinates, so each coupled configuration has the product law of 8NWX, and the indicators increase with q.
The one-edge cylinder probability gives expected open degree equal to the incident sum; a finite mean gives almost-sure finiteness, and a countable intersection gives one event.
